name: volute
from: volute/volute.py in this repository, not a cut file - there is no cut file.
how: Six semicircles of stepping radius, R82.3 down to R22.3, each starting where the last ended. The classical compass construction of a spiral, which is the only one offset() can follow: it mitres a vertex assuming the curvature either side is constant, true of an arc and false of a smooth spiral. Drawn here so the shape can be seen; it is not cuttable, and volute.py reports why.

measured.note: the bore comes within 7.75mm of itself against a 20mm cheek band, and the openings are 135 degrees apart where opposed is 180. Both are the enclosed inner end.
